helpCenter.heading: Help center
helpCenter.intro: Quick answers to the most common questions about Kounouz Alafiya.

topics.title: How does honey verification work?
topics.body: Every request goes through a full chain: sample collection, lab analysis, then a final decision from the verification team. Follow each step from "My requests".

topics.title: How do I know a product is authentic?
topics.body: Scan the QR code on the product, or enter the printed code on the public verification page to see the full traceability chain.

topics.title: How do I create a new verification request?
topics.body: From the producer dashboard, click "Verify my honey" and follow the three steps.

topics.title: Who answers support tickets?
topics.body: The Admin team and the verification team track and reply to all support tickets from within the app.

items.q: Can I edit a request after submitting it?
items.a: No, but you can submit a new request or contact support to adjust the details before it's accepted.

items.q: Why am I not receiving some notifications?
items.a: Check your notification preferences on the Settings page — that notification type may be turned off.
Not yet — this feature is under development.

items.q: How do I recover my password?
items.a: Contact support by opening a ticket and a team member will help you.

contact.heading: Contact Kounouz
contact.intro: Send us a message and our team will get back to you.
contact.success: Your message was sent successfully, thank you for reaching out.
